title: LauncherContent
description: The cars and tracks installed in Assetto Corsa, as the host launcher found them (GET /content on paddock-launcher).

ac_root.description: The Assetto Corsa folder that was scanned.

cars.description: Every folder of content/cars, by display name.

tracks.description: Every folder of content/tracks with at least one layout, by display name.

name.description: name in ui/ui_car.json; the id when the file is missing or unreadable.
Name of the track's first layout, without the layout's own words.

layout.description: Layout folder name; empty for a track with a single layout (ui/ui_track.json).

name.description: name in the layout's ui_track.json; the folder name otherwise.

ai_can_drive.description: True for a Paddock test copy (<layout>_paddock, tools/prepare_test_layout.py): only there may the agent hand the car to the AI.

test_copy.description: The layout id of this layout's test copy when it exists; empty otherwise and for a test copy itself.
